name: Echoes of Faith

source.title: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

disable: DC 26 Occultism check (expert) to exorcise the spirits, or DC 28 Deception check or DC 28 Religion check (trained) to imitate the Arodenite faith and render the haunt harmless until it resets
reset: The spirits return in 1d8 hours as long as any xulgaths remain in Moonstone Hall.

items.name: Phantom Sermon
items.text:
Trigger A non-Arodenite creature approaches within 5 feet of the lectern

---
Effect A spectral minister appears before the pulpit, resembling an ever-shifting amalgamation of several past priests. The spectral minister delivers fervent exhortations about faithlessness. Each creature on the dais must succeed at a DC 24 Will save save or become Drained 2. On a critical failure, the creature is Drained 4.

text: The restless spirits of clergy who once inhabited this now-defiled temple of Aroden remain within the sanctuary and pulpit.
